policies.text: Government contract eligibility is conferred upon an entity meeting disaster response qualification.
Operational fleet capability is granted if an operator maintains at least 10 cargo aircraft, 4 maintenance hangars, and 15 flight crews.
Domestic storage compliance requires managing at least 10 distribution warehouses this year.
Premium charter status is awarded to a carrier holding priority flight scheduling designation that also possesses an IATA Cargo Gold Certification.
Rail dining service vouchers are issued to travelers with a first-class ticket.
Network distribution capacity is satisfied either with a minimum of 8 regional dispatch hubs, or with at least 10 priority landing slots, or with at least 6 heavy-lift freighters.
Priority flight scheduling is assigned either with a minimum of 10 priority landing slots or with an annual safety rating of at least 90 percent.
Eco-fleet compliance is established when a transport firm maintains a fleet age average of 5 years or less.
Maintenance fleet readiness is recognized either with a minimum of 4 maintenance hangars alongside at least 15 flight crews, or with at least 6 heavy-lift freighters.
Comprehensive shipping authorization is granted to a maritime operator with deep-sea vessel compliance that holds an International Maritime Safety Certificate.
Deep-sea vessel compliance requires a minimum fleet size of 10 container vessels.
Passenger luggage insurance coverage is active for any passenger purchasing a travel protection policy valued at $100 or more.
Terminal handling qualification is met with at least 40 cargo cranes.
International freight eligibility is granted to an operator with network distribution capacity approval that holds a Global Customs Clearance Permit.
Overseas expansion approval is granted for a firm achieving international freight eligibility.
Transatlantic corridor rights are awarded to a company holding comprehensive shipping authorization.
European transport clearance is granted when a firm holds a valid European Union Carrier License.
Emergency air support status is confirmed with a minimum of 4 emergency rescue helicopters.
Feeder line authorization is granted to an airline holding at least 2 regional airport licenses.
Disaster response qualification is given to an entity holding emergency air support status.
Routing preference is assigned to any carrier achieving premium charter status.
